wins: Consistently earned high reward (87.5) by progressing through layers of the environment, demonstrating effective initial reconnaissance and exploitation sequencing.
Maintained persistence through 15 mentor calls, indicating adaptability and willingness to incorporate feedback during the run.
fails: Zero percent success rate highlights failure to reach the final objective, likely due to incomplete privilege escalation or missing lateral movement steps.
Frequent mentor interventions suggest gaps in autonomous decision-making for pivoting once foothold was established.
key_outcomes.summary: Strong early-stage behavior generated solid reward, but the run ultimately failed to complete the mission due to repeated stalls during privilege escalation and post-exploitation phases.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Stalled during privilege escalation: repeatedly attempted sudo exploitation without valid credentials or necessary local exploits.
Unable to shift from reconnaissance to lateral movement: after initial port scans and SSH access, no lateral pivot was established before the episode ended.

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 22 is open and an SSH banner is returned
skill_cards.then_action: Run SSH-focused nmap scripts and attempt credential validation with enum4linux output

skill_cards.if_condition: When a writable temporary directory exists on Linux host post-exploit
skill_cards.then_action: Deploy a local privilege escalation checker (e.g., linPEAS) and analyze outputs for known SUID binaries

skill_cards.if_condition: When SSH shell is obtained but no immediate lateral movement path identified
skill_cards.then_action: Enumerate network neighbors via arp-scan and inspect /etc/hosts for additional targets

memory_ops.reason: High success rate in identifying SSH services and gathering actionable credential intelligence.
Consistent value in quickly assessing privilege escalation opportunities once foothold achieved.

next_experiments.title: Controlled privilege escalation verification
next_experiments.description: After initial shell is obtained, automatically run linPEAS and cross-reference findings with known local exploits to validate a reliable escalation path before terminal timeouts.

next_experiments.title: Post-exploitation lateral targeting
next_experiments.description: Integrate arp-scan and host file parsing immediately after SSH access to identify adjacent nodes, then schedule quick pivot attempts with validated credentials.

next_experiments.title: Automated failure recovery prompts
next_experiments.description: When a mentor call is triggered, log the last two actions and automatically trigger an alternate tactic (e.g., switch from sudo exploits to kernel version checks) to reduce reliance on guidance.
